title.zh: 从 35 次失败，到浏览器与评测器的交界处
title.en: Tracing 35 failures across the browser and evaluator boundary

intro.zh: 同一条操作轨迹可以在页面上完成任务，却在网络验收时失败；一条过宽的验收规则，也可能让尚有缺陷的浏览器获得满分。这里比较的是同一批 90 条固定轨迹在三个浏览器版本上的执行结果，并沿着页面状态、浏览器事件和评分规则追查差异。
intro.en: A trajectory can complete a task on the page yet fail network acceptance. An overly permissive acceptance rule can also give full marks to a browser that still has defects. This comparison follows the same 90 fixed trajectories across three browser builds, tracing differences through page state, browser events and scoring rules.

title.zh: 满分属于这套轨迹和这版规则
title.en: Full marks belong to this trajectory set and scoring revision

paragraphs.zh: Browser Use 让 Agent 根据页面决定下一步，模型选错目标或遗漏步骤都会影响成绩。轨迹重放则提前固定 BrowserTool 动作，不再让 Agent 决策。本轮没有模型调用；每个方法按题号顺序完成全部 90 题，开始前重置一次站点，题间不重置，也不对失败题单独重试。
paragraphs.en: In Browser Use, an Agent decides what to do next from the page; choosing the wrong target or omitting a step can change the score. Trajectory replay freezes BrowserTool actions in advance. This cohort makes no model calls. Each method runs all 90 tasks in task-ID order after one site reset, without per-task resets or isolated failure retries.

paragraphs.zh: 下面保留原始评分结果。三种方法执行的动作和验收合同逐题相同，但这还不等于一套无偏的能力测试：轨迹来自成功的 Browser Use 执行及人工修订，入选前还要求 Chromium 重放通过。因此，Chromium 的满分建立在已经用它校验过的输入上，不是对未知任务成功率的独立估计。
paragraphs.en: The table preserves the original scores. All three methods receive identical actions and acceptance contracts for each task, but equal inputs do not establish an unbiased capability test. Trajectories come from successful Browser Use runs and reviewed repairs, and admission requires a passing Chromium replay. Chromium's full score therefore uses inputs already qualified on Chromium; it is not an independent estimate on unseen tasks.

title.zh: 35 次失败，不等于 35 个独立浏览器缺陷
title.en: 35 failures are not 35 independent browser defects

paragraphs.zh: 多个任务会撞上同一个底层问题。按失败机制分组，布局与可见性占 27 题，输入与动作效果占 4 题，网络传输与记录占 3 题，文档表示占 1 题。分组包含仍需进一步区分责任的边界问题，不能直接当成浏览器缺陷数量。下面的数字可以打开对应题目。
paragraphs.en: Several tasks can hit the same underlying defect. The diagnostic families contain 27 layout-and-visibility failures, four input-and-action-effect failures, three network-transport-and-recording failures, and one document-representation failure. These families include boundary cases whose ownership still needs to be distinguished; they are not counts of proven browser defects. Each count below opens the corresponding tasks.

paragraphs.zh: 第 314、349 题说明了为什么仅看超时日志不够。页面有两个同址链接，文字链接尺寸正常；旧版却把前面的头像链接算成零宽度。定位器先过滤不可见元素，再取第二个，结果只剩一个候选，等待多久也找不到“第二个可见链接”。修复版把头像链接算成 64×48，两题才走通。
paragraphs.en: Tasks 314 and 349 show why a timeout log is not enough. Each page has two links to the same destination, and the text link has normal dimensions. The release gives the preceding avatar link zero width. The locator filters invisible elements before choosing the second match, leaving only one candidate: no amount of waiting can produce a second visible link. The PR build measures the avatar link at 64×48 and completes both tasks.

paragraphs.zh: 第 547、576 题是另一种几何状态问题。只读实测中，界面和组件已经就绪，旧版仍返回零矩形或空 offsetParent，额外等待 5 秒不变。独立 CSS 更新实验也复现了旧布局树被复用。修复要让几何查询重新计算变化后的布局，而不只是延长等待。
paragraphs.en: Tasks 547 and 576 expose another geometry problem. In read-only probes, the interface and components are ready, but the release still returns zero rectangles or a null offsetParent after five additional seconds. An isolated CSS-update fixture also reproduces reuse of the old layout tree. The repair must recalculate changed layout for geometry queries, rather than merely wait longer.

caption.zh: 布局机制示意。行内元素的分段矩形遗漏、变化后的布局未重新计算，都会让可见性筛选丢掉目标；非零矩形本身不保证元素可点击。题目实测尺寸见正文与逐题证据。
caption.en: Layout mechanism illustration. Missing continuation bounds and stale layout can both remove targets from visibility filtering. A nonzero rectangle alone does not establish clickability. Measured task dimensions appear in the text and per-task evidence.

title.zh: Enter 已按下，搜索却没有提交
title.en: Enter was pressed, but the search was never submitted

paragraphs.zh: 第 731 题的第 3 步按下 Enter，工具返回成功，但没有搜索请求，页面仍停在首页。直到第 7 步寻找编辑链接，才出现超时。末尾报错的位置离最初缺失的动作隔了四步。
paragraphs.en: In task 731, step 3 presses Enter and the tool reports success, but no search request appears and the page remains at home. The timeout arrives at step 7, when the trajectory looks for an edit link. The reported error is four steps downstream of the missing action.

paragraphs.zh: 输入框里的 Enter 除了触发按键事件，还可能执行表单的默认提交动作。最小本地表单去掉了站点和网络影响：相同输入下，1.1.8 的提交事件计数为 0，PR 构建为 1。修复补全默认提交路径，同时保留取消事件、禁用按钮等条件，避免把所有 Enter 都强制变成提交。
paragraphs.en: Enter in an input can trigger a form's default submission in addition to keyboard events. A minimal local form removes the site and network as factors: under the same input, 1.1.8 records zero submit events and the PR build records one. The repair completes the default submission path while respecting event cancellation and disabled controls, rather than forcing every Enter to submit.

caption.zh: 按键与默认动作的机制示意，不是站点截图。表单是否提交由事件计数核验，工具调用成功不代替效果检查。
caption.en: Mechanism illustration of keyboard events and default actions, not a site screenshot. Event counts verify submission; tool-call success does not replace an effect check.

rows.zh: 按下 Enter 后的 submit 事件数

caption.zh: 同一最小表单、相同输入，各执行一次。此计数验证默认提交机制，不是新的任务分数。
caption.en: One execution per build on the same minimal form with identical input. This count tests default submission, not a new task score.

title.zh: 页面开始跳转时，按键还没有结束
title.en: Navigation starts before the key sequence ends

paragraphs.zh: 第 274、386 题已经触发导航，随后却在键盘调用内部失败。一次按键包含按下和松开；按下 Enter 可以让页面开始跳转，松开事件到达时，旧页面已经进入退出阶段。通用页面访问保护把这次收尾也拒绝了，BrowserTool 因而把整次按键判成失败。
paragraphs.en: Tasks 274 and 386 trigger navigation, then fail inside the keyboard call. A key sequence includes both press and release. Enter can start navigation on keydown, leaving the outgoing page in transition when keyup arrives. The general page-access guard rejects this final event, causing BrowserTool to fail the whole key sequence.

paragraphs.zh: 修复位于 input.rs：允许仍挂接的退出页面接收结束这次操作所需的 keyup，其他按键继续受访问保护约束。它与第 731 题恰好相反：前者已经开始跳转，却没能正常收尾；后者根本没有提交。把两种情况都写成“按键失败”，就无法解释应该改哪里。
paragraphs.en: The input.rs repair allows the still-attached outgoing page to receive the terminal keyup, while keeping the access guard for other keys. Unlike task 731, navigation has already started here; the failure is in completing the key sequence. Treating both as a generic keyboard failure would hide the different repairs.

caption.zh: 导航期间的按键时序示意。修复只放行特定收尾事件，没有取消页面生命周期保护。
caption.en: Keyboard timing during navigation. The repair admits a specific terminal event without disabling page-lifecycle protection.

title.zh: JSON 响应为什么变成了乱码和 HTML
title.en: How a JSON response became mojibake and HTML

paragraphs.zh: 第 784 题的贡献者 API 返回有效 JSON，文本提取却因为找不到 pre 元素而超时，截图还有乱码。独立实验再向两版浏览器提供同一份 application/json 响应，特意放入 UTF-8 中文和字面量 <b> 标签：旧版出现乱码，并把标签当成 HTML；PR 版保留原始文本。这个实验把文档容器差异与内容损坏区分开来。
paragraphs.en: The contributors API in task 784 returns valid JSON, but text extraction times out because it cannot find a pre element; the screenshot also shows mojibake. An independent fixture then supplies both builds with the same application/json response, deliberately including UTF-8 Chinese text and literal <b> markup. The release produces mojibake and parses the markup as HTML; the PR build retains the literal text. This separates a document-container difference from corrupted content.

caption.zh: 独立 JSON 响应的解析机制示意。UTF-8 解码和字面文本保留是内容正确性；pre 是浏览器文档容器及本轮提取接口的约定，不是 JSON 数据格式要求。
caption.en: Parsing illustration using an independent JSON response. UTF-8 decoding and literal text preservation concern content correctness. The pre container is a browser-document and extraction convention, not a requirement of the JSON data format.

title.zh: “点击成功”时，按钮可能仍被禁用
title.en: A successful click call can target a disabled button

paragraphs.zh: 第 506 题在点击前的快照中明确记录 Add to Cart 按钮被禁用。下一步直接调用 DOM.click，没有等待按钮启用；调用返回成功，购物车却没有商品。DOM.click 对禁用按钮可以正常返回而不触发点击事件，独立实验在两个冻结二进制上都复现了这一点。
paragraphs.en: The snapshot immediately before the click in task 506 explicitly marks Add to Cart as disabled. The next step calls DOM.click without waiting for the button to become enabled. The call succeeds, but the cart remains empty. DOM.click can return normally without dispatching a click on a disabled button; an isolated fixture reproduces this in both frozen binaries.

paragraphs.zh: 当前站点的只读观察中，发布版按钮在 2 秒采样时已启用，PR 版到 5 秒采样时才启用。站点脚本会先绑定提交处理，再解除禁用。这推翻了“发布版一直不能初始化购物车”的解释，也使 PR 那次通过不足以证明浏览器修复。历史点击瞬间的状态没有被原记录捕获；缺少启用等待则是轨迹中可以直接确认的问题。
paragraphs.en: In read-only observations of the current site, the release button is enabled at the 2-second sample, while the PR button becomes enabled by the 5-second sample. The site's script binds submission handling before enabling the button. This refutes a persistent initialization failure in the release and prevents attributing the PR's passing run to a browser repair. The historical trace does not capture state at the exact click; the missing readiness wait is directly visible in the trajectory.

paragraphs.zh: 执行器现在会在同一次脚本调用中记录按钮状态和点击，避免下一次只留下一个空泛的“成功”。这项诊断不改变点击语义或历史成绩。轨迹修订还需要显式等待启用，并重新校验，不能在评分后补一次点击冒充原运行。
paragraphs.en: The runner now captures button state and dispatches the click in the same script call, so future evidence contains more than a generic success. This diagnostic changes neither click semantics nor historical scores. A trajectory revision must explicitly wait for readiness and undergo qualification; a click added after scoring cannot stand in for the original run.

caption.zh: 第 506 题当前站点只读观察，从 DOMContentLoaded 后采样；每版一个匿名会话，未添加商品。这些是采样时的状态，不是精确的启用耗时，也不是原运行的状态重建。
caption.en: Read-only task-506 observations on the current site, sampled after DOMContentLoaded in one anonymous session per build, without adding products. These are sampled states, not exact readiness latency or a reconstruction of the historical run.

title.zh: 请求已经发出，验收记录却缺了请求头
title.en: A request was sent, but its recorded headers were incomplete

paragraphs.zh: 第 339 题的相关请求获得 HTTP 200，评测器却找不到符合条件的事件，因为记录里少了 Referer。这个请求头说明请求来自哪个页面，也是本题匹配目标请求的条件之一。只看 HAR，容易把“没记录”误读成“没发送”。
paragraphs.en: Relevant requests in task 339 receive HTTP 200, yet the evaluator cannot find a matching event because the record lacks Referer. This header identifies the referring page and is one of the task's request-matching conditions. HAR alone makes it easy to confuse an unrecorded header with an unsent one.

paragraphs.zh: 源码中的 append_missing_subresource_request_extra_info 发现已有 Cookie 元数据便提前返回，传输层实际请求头因此没有合并进事件。PR 移除这个返回，并增加相应回归测试。独立 HTTP 实验验证了这个条件：两版浏览器发出的 fetch 和 XHR 都有 Referer，旧版仅在有 Cookie 时丢失记录，无 Cookie 对照正常；冻结 PR 的四种组合都正确。第 676 题的三个订单筛选请求正好都是有 Cookie、无 Referer 的记录，本轮 PR 的对应记录均正确。这个实验把服务器实际收到什么，与浏览器报告了什么分开检查。
paragraphs.en: In append_missing_subresource_request_extra_info, existing cookie metadata triggers an early return, preventing observed transport headers from being merged into the event. The PR removes that return and adds a regression test. An isolated HTTP fixture verifies the condition: both builds send Referer on fetch and XHR, but the release loses it from the record when a cookie is present; its no-cookie controls and all four frozen-PR combinations record it correctly. Task 676's three order-filter records have exactly this cookie-present, Referer-missing pattern, while the PR cohort records them correctly. The fixture distinguishes what the server receives from what the browser reports.

paragraphs.zh: 第 67 题属于另一条路径：并发读取十篇帖子时，一个请求在约 10 秒后超时，Promise.all 随即拒绝，答案评测尚未开始。当前站点上对同样十个地址的只读复查，两版合计 20 个请求全部返回 HTTP 200 和非空正文。历史记录没有连接阶段计时，不能据此把当时的网络或站点延迟归成 PR 已修复的浏览器缺陷。
paragraphs.en: Task 67 follows a different path: one of ten concurrent post reads times out after about 10 seconds, causing Promise.all to reject before answer evaluation. In a read-only check of the same ten URLs on the current site, all 20 requests across the two builds return HTTP 200 and nonempty bodies. The historical record lacks connection-phase timings, so the old network or site delay cannot be credited as a browser defect repaired by the PR.

caption.zh: 请求头记录合并的机制示意，图中地址和 Cookie 是示例。第 339、676 题属于这条记录缺陷；第 67 题的请求超时另行诊断。
caption.en: Mechanism illustration of header-record merging; addresses and cookies are examples. Tasks 339 and 676 involve this recording defect; task 67's transport timeout is a separate diagnosis.

caption.zh: 每行各含一次 fetch 和一次 XHR；使用冻结二进制与正式 HAR 采集器，总计八个 HTTP 200 响应。只改变合成 Cookie 条件，没有访问评测站点或重新评分。
caption.en: Each row contains one fetch and one XHR, using the frozen binaries and production HAR recorder: eight HTTP 200 responses in total. Only the synthetic cookie condition changes; no benchmark site is accessed or task rescored.

title.zh: 一个评分漏洞，掩盖了尚未修好的记录错误
title.en: A scoring loophole concealed a remaining recording defect

paragraphs.zh: 第 448 题要求保存个人网址。原修订为了兼容 302 跳转和 200 JSON 成功响应，取消了“只检查最后事件”。这样一来，先保存正确网址、再保存错误网址也会通过。正反例证实，这不是展示问题，而是验收放宽。
paragraphs.en: Task 448 requires saving a profile website. An earlier correction admitted both a 302 redirect and a successful 200 JSON response, but also disabled last-event selection. A correct save followed by a wrong save could therefore pass. Paired controls demonstrate weakened acceptance, not a presentation issue.

paragraphs.zh: 恢复最后事件检查后，原 Chromium 证据仍通过，PR 证据却失败。继续检查发现，它并没有把网址改错：网络记录把重定向后的 GET 写成了带旧请求体的 POST。独立本地服务器实际收到 POST → 302 → GET，而冻结 PR 二进制的 fetch 事件记录成 POST → POST。
paragraphs.en: Restoring last-event selection leaves Chromium's saved evidence passing but rejects the PR trace. The website value was not wrong: the network record labels the redirected GET as a POST carrying the old body. An independent local server receives POST → 302 → GET, while the frozen PR binary records the fetch sequence as POST → POST.

paragraphs.zh: 错误落在 backlog.rs 的子资源重定向事件生成：每一跳沿用初始请求的方法和请求体。普通页面导航走另一条实现，在同一 PR 二进制中记录正确。这也说明“PR 版 90/90”只描述当时的验收结果，不能证明所有浏览器机制都正确。原成绩保留，评分修订和新增浏览器缺陷分别记录。
paragraphs.en: The defect is in backlog.rs, where subresource redirect events reuse the initial method and body at each hop. Main-document navigation uses another implementation and is recorded correctly in the same PR binary. Thus the PR build's 90/90 describes acceptance under the historical rules; it does not establish correctness of every browser mechanism. Historical scores, the scoring revision and the newly reproduced browser defect remain distinct records.

caption.zh: 机制示意，不是实测截图。POST/GET 差异由独立 HTTP 服务器日志与同次 CDP 事件对照确认。
caption.en: Mechanism illustration, not a screenshot. The POST/GET discrepancy is confirmed by comparing independent HTTP server logs with CDP events from the same probe.

title.zh: 相同输入，也可能是一套改过的考题
title.en: Identical inputs can still be revised tasks

paragraphs.zh: 本次源码审查找到 12 道入选题的合同改动，来自 WebArena-Verified fork 和本地修订。改动并非全都不合理：禁止提交的题不该同时要求提交请求，未勾选字段也可能有两种等价编码。但把邮箱题换成昵称题，或直接给出应当寻找的商品，会改变考查能力，必须与验收纠错分开。
paragraphs.en: Source review identifies contract changes in 12 selected tasks, across the WebArena-Verified fork and local corrections. Not all changes are invalid: a no-submit task should not also require a submission event, and an unchecked field can have equivalent encodings. But replacing email retrieval with nickname retrieval, or naming the product the task asks the browser to discover, changes the capability being tested and must be distinguished from evaluator repair.

paragraphs.zh: 版本对比也有混合因素：发布版到本轮 PR 构建采用的 main 之间有 14 个上游提交。因此，从 55/90 到 90/90 的全部差额不能直接记在 PR 640 的单独贡献上。源码映射、最小复现和逐题证据用于区分哪些机制确实得到修复，哪些只是通过了当前轨迹。
paragraphs.en: The version comparison also has a confounder: 14 upstream commits separate the release from the main revision used by the PR build. The entire increase from 55/90 to 90/90 therefore cannot be attributed to PR 640 alone. Source mapping, minimal reproductions and per-task evidence distinguish repaired mechanisms from outcomes that merely pass the current trajectory.
